title: Grid Hunger
description: A raw, percussion-driven dance-pop track built on a thundering 808 kit and punchy square-wave stabs. Two surge peaks bracket a stripped valley where only the kick and a lone bassline hold the floor. Syncopated hats and euclidean rim patterns keep the groove restless from first bar to last.
